title: Study to Test Effects and Safety of RO7568282 In Early Parkinson’s Disease
official: A Phase II, Randomized, Double-Blind, Placebo-Controlled, Multicenter Study to Evaluate the Efficacy, Safety, and Pharmacokinetics of RO7568282 in Participants with Early-Stage Parkinson’s Disease
summary: Main objective: To evaluate the efficacy of RO7568282 compared with placebo
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Diagnosis of idiopathic Parkinson’s disease
2. Has received stable doses of monotherapy treatment with levodopa for at least 2 months prior to baseline
3. A Movement Disorder Society - Unified Parkinson's Disease Rating Scale (MDS-UPDRS) Part IV score of 0 at screening and prior to randomization at baseline
4. Hoehn and Yahr (H&Y) Stage ≤ 3 (assessed in off medication state) at screening and prior to randomization at baseline
5. Able to swallow whole capsules
6. Participants must be aged 40 to 85 years, inclusive, at the time of signing the Informed Consent Form
Exclusion criteria:
1. Medical history indicating a parkinsonian syndrome other than idiopathic Parkinson’s disease
2. Diagnosis of Parkinson’s Disease dementia
3. Diagnosis of a significant neurologic disease other than Parkinson’s Disease
4. Within the last year, unstable or clinically significant cardiovascular disease
5. Chronic uncontrolled hypertension
6. History or presence of brain MRI scan showing evidence of structural abnormalities, other than related to Parkinson’s disease
